title: MODERNISATION OF CAPF
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Home Affairs

MODERNISATION OF CAPF

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
04 AUG 2026 3:27PM by PIB Delhi

The major measures undertaken for the modernization of Central Armed Police Forces (CAPFs) include induction of modern weapons, surveillance and communication systems, mobility platforms, force protection equipment, operational infrastructure and advanced technologies, through a Central Sector  Scheme, namely Modernization Plan-IV for CAPFs. The major items provided to CAPFs through this Scheme during the last three years include:



(i)      Modern weapon systems and combat equipment: Assault rifles, Glock pistols with Corner Shot systems, modern arms and ammunition and weapon accessories.



(ii)     Surveillance and intelligence systems: Thermal imagers, passive night vision goggles, UAVs/drones, Automatic Fire Detection and Suppression Systems and other electronic surveillance equipment.



(iii)    Communication and Information Technology: Secure communication equipment, Hyper-Converged Infrastructure (HCI) servers/nodes, networking infrastructure, command-and-control systems and digital operational platforms.



(iv)    Mobility and specialized vehicles: Medium Bullet Proof Vehicles, Light Bullet Proof Vehicles, Mine Protected Vehicles, Wheel Armoured Platforms, Emergency Rescue Fire Tenders and Rubberized Inflatable Boats.



(v)     Force protection equipment: Bullet-resistant jackets, ballistic helmets, protective shields and other personal protective equipment.



(vi)    Specialized operational equipment: Counter-IED/bomb disposal equipment, rescue and disaster response equipment and specialized tactical gear.



(vii)   Infrastructure: Modern training facilities, communication infrastructure, logistics support systems, ICT infrastructure, maintenance facilities and other operational infrastructure to support border guarding and internal security operations.



Force-wise and year-wise funds allotted to CAPFs and expenditure incurred under Modernization Plan-IV are given in Annexure-A.



As a result of the modernization measures, the operational capability of CAPFs has improved significantly and these interventions have enhanced operational preparedness, mobility, situational awareness, surveillance,  force protection, intelligence gathering and response capability, thereby strengthening border guarding, counter-insurgency, anti-Naxal and other internal security operations and to effectively address emerging security challenges.
